title: Feature attention graph neural network for estimating brain age and identifying important neural connections in mouse models of genetic risk for Alzheimer's disease
summary: A feature-attention graph neural network estimated brain age and identified important neural connections in mouse models of genetic risk for Alzheimer's disease, within the scope and limitations the paper states. The findings are limited to the reported dataset, setup and validation; broader generalization and real-world benefit were not established.
